language.zh: 阿拉伯语、柏柏尔语、法语

geography.zh: 摩洛哥位于非洲西北部，北临地中海，西临大西洋，与欧洲最近处仅14公里。阿特拉斯山脉横贯中部，撒哈拉沙漠覆盖南部地区。地形多样，气候温和。
geography.en: Morocco is in northwestern Africa, bordering the Mediterranean to the north and Atlantic to the west, just 14 km from Europe at its closest point. The Atlas Mountains cross the center; the Sahara Desert covers the south. Diverse terrain with a mild climate.

history.zh: 摩洛哥是非洲最古老的王国之一，柏柏尔人在此居住数千年。7世纪阿拉伯人带来了伊斯兰教，中世纪摩洛哥王国曾是伊斯兰世界的重要中心。1912年成为法国和西班牙的保护国，1956年独立。
history.en: Morocco is one of Africa's oldest kingdoms; Berbers have lived here for millennia. Arabs brought Islam in the 7th century; the medieval Moroccan kingdom was an important center of the Islamic world. Morocco became a French and Spanish protectorate in 1912 and gained independence in 1956.

economy.zh: 摩洛哥经济以磷酸盐开采（全球储量第一）、旅游业、农业和纺织业为主。近年来大力发展可再生能源和汽车制造业，成为非洲重要的制造业基地。马拉喀什和非斯是重要旅游城市。
economy.en: Morocco's economy centers on phosphate mining (world's largest reserves), tourism, agriculture and textiles. Recent development of renewable energy and automobile manufacturing has made it an important African manufacturing hub. Marrakech and Fes are major tourist cities.

population.zh: 摩洛哥人口约3700万，主要由阿拉伯人和柏柏尔人（阿马齐格人）组成。伊斯兰教是国教，几乎所有摩洛哥人都是穆斯林。法语在商业和教育领域广泛使用。
population.en: Morocco has ~37 million people, mainly Arabs and Berbers (Amazigh). Islam is the state religion; nearly all Moroccans are Muslim. French is widely used in business and education.

culture.zh: 摩洛哥文化融合了柏柏尔、阿拉伯、伊斯兰和法国文化元素，独具魅力。马拉喀什的集市广场（德吉玛艾尔法纳广场）是世界非物质文化遗产。摩洛哥建筑以精美的马赛克拼贴、雕花石膏和彩色琉璃瓦著称。薄荷茶是重要的待客礼仪。
culture.en: Moroccan culture uniquely blends Berber, Arab, Islamic and French elements. Marrakech's Jemaa el-Fnaa square is UNESCO intangible heritage. Moroccan architecture is renowned for intricate mosaic tilework, carved plaster and zellige ceramics. Mint tea is an important hospitality ritual.
